role: New working foundation with native CC0 topology, not an accepted finished character
visualObservations: The untreated native face preserves a continuous philtrum, malar surface, jaw, and lip boundary without the r0003/r0004 radial fan creases.

The lips retain a native seam but convincing mouth opening and oral anatomy remain unproven.
The side and back silhouette and neutral body can serve as a source reference; joint deformation and anatomical detailing still require work.
remainingRequiredWork: neutral and dynamic collision with fitted components
walking, running, crouching, turn and expressions

decision: Retain this native foundation for subsequent character construction. Keep the r0001 legacy baseline for comparison, and generate no runtime actor until quality and integration gates pass.
